title: 质粒、细菌与遗传转化（国内版）
source_doc: course/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/02_APB - Plasmids and Bacteria.md
author_source: project/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/02_APB - Plasmids and Bacteria（国内版）/src.py

points.K4: 质粒可以剪开、插入、复制
points.K7: 受体菌：无害的实验室菌株
points.S1: 转化实验先评估、再审批

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，身边浮着一个环状DNA
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a glowing circular DNA ring floating next to it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲质粒、细菌和遗传转化。

shots.scene: 质粒环、细菌、培养皿、盾牌四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a circular plasmid ring, a rod-shaped bacterium, a petri dish and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 先懂原理，再守规矩做实验。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着四个空白培养皿，一脸困惑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds four petri dishes with blank labels and looks confused.
shots.narration: 阿杰配好了四种平板，却不知道有啥用。

shots.scene: 小研指着白板上画的环状DNA
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a simple drawing of a circular DNA ring on a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 小研说：先弄懂质粒，再动手转化。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前举起一个小细菌模型
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small toy model of a rod-shaped bacterium in front of a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 我们从遗传转化讲起。

shots.scene: 一个基因片段从左边的细胞飞向右边的细胞
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a short colored gene segment moving with an arrow from one cell on the left into another cell on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 遗传转化，是把基因从一种生物转到另一种。

shots.scene: 基因片段装在一个小环形载体里传送
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a gene segment carried inside a small circular DNA carrier traveling between two cells. No people.
shots.narration: 它借助人工改造的DNA分子来运送。

shots.scene: 接受了新基因的细胞发出淡淡的光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a cell that has received a new gene, now shining with a soft new color. No people.
shots.narration: 得到外来基因的生物，叫转基因生物。

shots.scene: 欣欣在三个“修饰方法”图标中圈出其中一个
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot circles one of three method icons on a blank board.
shots.narration: 转化，是现代遗传修饰的一种方法。

shots.scene: 海面油污上，细菌图标在分解油滴
shots.prompt_en: Icon of an oil slick on water with small bacteria icons breaking the oil droplets apart. No people.
shots.narration: 比如能分解溢油的细菌，

shots.scene: 玉米植株旁，一只害虫被挡开
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a healthy corn plant with a pest insect bouncing off a shield around it. No people.
shots.narration: 能抵抗特定害虫的作物，

shots.scene: 细菌图标旁边是药瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a bacterium next to a small medicine vial with a protein symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 还有能生产药用蛋白的细菌。

shots.scene: 细菌示意图：中间一团大染色体，旁边几个小环
shots.prompt_en: Cross-section diagram of a bacterium with one large tangled chromosome in the middle and a few small separate DNA rings nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 质粒是染色体之外的DNA。

shots.scene: 小环复制出另一个小环
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a small circular DNA ring copying itself into two identical rings. No people.
shots.narration: 它是环状的，能自己复制。

shots.scene: 小环和大染色体各自工作，互不干扰
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a small DNA ring and a large chromosome side by side, each with its own green check, not touching. No people.
shots.narration: 它不干扰宿主染色体的正常工作。

shots.section_title: 质粒可以剪开、插入、复制
shots.scene: 环上标出几段不同颜色的基因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a circular plasmid with several colored segments marked as genes. No people.
shots.narration: 质粒上带着基因。
overlay: 质粒可以剪开、插入、复制

shots.section_title: 质粒可以剪开、插入、复制
shots.scene: 一把小剪刀把环剪开一个口
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a small pair of molecular scissors cutting the plasmid ring open at one point. No people.
shots.narration: 用限制性内切酶，可以把它剪开一个口。

shots.section_title: 质粒可以剪开、插入、复制
shots.scene: 新的基因片段嵌进缺口，环重新闭合
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a new colored gene segment fitting into the gap and the ring closing again. No people.
shots.narration: 放进新基因，环重新闭合。

shots.section_title: 质粒可以剪开、插入、复制
shots.scene: 闭合的环在细胞质里复制成多个
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the closed plasmid ring multiplying into several copies inside a cell. No people.
shots.narration: 闭合后，它会在宿主细胞里复制。

shots.scene: 细菌细胞膜上开小口，质粒进入
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a small plasmid ring passing through the membrane into a bacterium. No people.
shots.narration: 细菌能摄取小片段DNA。

shots.scene: 质粒周围出现绿色小点和盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a bacterium with a plasmid inside producing small green dots and a small shield symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 质粒上的基因，就能在细菌里表达。

shots.scene: 一个环状质粒图，上面有绿色发光段和盾牌段
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a circular plasmid with a green glowing segment and a segment marked with a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 课堂用的是商品化的教学用发光质粒。

shots.scene: 绿色发光的水母图标和荧光蛋白图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a glowing green jellyfish next to a small green fluorescent protein icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一个基因让细菌发出绿色荧光，

shots.scene: 抗生素药片图标被盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: Icon of an antibiotic capsule bouncing off a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 另一个让细菌能抵抗氨苄青霉素。

shots.scene: 一把钥匙插进发光基因的锁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a small key labeled with a sugar symbol unlocking the green glowing gene segment. No people.
shots.narration: 发光基因要靠阿拉伯糖来开启。

shots.scene: 培养皿里的菌落发出绿光，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a petri dish with green glowing colonies and a green check beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 看到发光，就说明转化成功了。

shots.section_title: 受体菌：无害的实验室菌株
shots.scene: 一个圆头杆状细菌图标，旁边打着绿色勾
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a friendly-looking rod-shaped bacterium with a green check beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 受体菌是大肠杆菌的一个实验室菌株。
overlay: 受体菌：无害的实验室菌株

shots.section_title: 受体菌：无害的实验室菌株
shots.scene: 两个细菌图标并排：一个打勾，一个带骷髅标记被隔开
shots.prompt_en: Two bacteria icons side by side: one with a green check, the other with a red warning mark kept behind a barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 它无害、常用，别和致病菌株混为一谈。

shots.section_title: 受体菌：无害的实验室菌株
shots.scene: 未转化细菌遇到抗生素后消失
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of plain bacteria fading away when antibiotic capsules surround them. No people.
shots.narration: 没被转化的它，遇到氨苄就活不了。

shots.scene: 四个培养皿排成一排，标签空白
shots.prompt_en: Four petri dishes in a row with blank labels on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 四个平板，成分组合各不相同。

shots.scene: 暂停键图标和一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A large pause button icon with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 先暂停：会长菌落吗？会发光吗？

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白笔记本上画四个圆圈写预测
shots.prompt_en: The young male student draws four circles in a blank notebook and writes his predictions under each.
shots.narration: 四个平板都写下预测，再写理由。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研对照着比较两份笔记
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student compare two notebooks side by side.
shots.narration: 然后再对照专家的答案。

shots.scene: 第一个平板高亮，布满白色菌落
shots.prompt_en: The first of four petri dishes is highlighted, covered with many white bacterial colonies, no glow. No people.
shots.narration: 平板1只有普通培养基，没加质粒。

shots.scene: 菌落密布，旁边发光图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the first dish full of colonies, with a glow icon beside it crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 细菌长得很多，但不会发光。

shots.scene: 第二个平板高亮，空空如也
shots.prompt_en: The second petri dish is highlighted and is completely empty with no colonies. No people.
shots.narration: 平板2加了氨苄，没加质粒。

shots.scene: 抗生素图标挡住细菌
shots.prompt_en: Icon of antibiotic capsules surrounding bacteria that fade away. No people.
shots.narration: 氨苄抑制细菌，所以一个菌落都不长。

shots.scene: 第三个平板高亮，只有零星几个白色菌落
shots.prompt_en: The third petri dish is highlighted with only a few scattered white colonies. No people.
shots.narration: 平板3有氨苄，也加了质粒。

shots.scene: 很多细菌中只有少数带着质粒环
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of many bacteria where only a few contain a small plasmid ring and survive. No people.
shots.narration: 只有摄取了质粒的少数细菌能长出来。

shots.scene: 零星菌落旁，发光图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The few colonies on the third dish with a glow icon beside them crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 缺少激活剂，它们不发光。

shots.scene: 第四个平板高亮，零星菌落发绿光
shots.prompt_en: The fourth petri dish is highlighted with a few colonies glowing bright green under a dim lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 平板4再加了阿拉伯糖。

shots.scene: 四个平板并排，第三、四个打勾少量菌，只有第四个发光
shots.prompt_en: Four petri dishes side by side: the third and fourth have a few colonies, and only the fourth glows green. No people.
shots.narration: 有质粒和氨苄的，只长少量菌落；

shots.scene: 欣欣指着发光的第四个平板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the fourth petri dish glowing green.
shots.narration: 只有加了阿拉伯糖的那个会发光。

shots.scene: 笔记本上三处荧光笔标记和一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A notebook page with three highlighted lines and a question mark in the margin. No people.
shots.narration: 划出三条要点，连上旧知识，写下疑问。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿笔记向王老师请教
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds his notes and asks the safety administrator a question.
shots.narration: 疑问拿去和老师讨论。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰站在实验台前，台上摆着平板和冰盒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student stand at a lab bench with petri dishes and an ice box, both in lab coats and goggles.
shots.narration: 下一个活动，亲手把质粒转进细菌。

shots.section_title: 转化实验先评估、再审批
shots.scene: 小研在空白风险评估表上逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ticks items on a blank risk assessment form at a desk.
shots.narration: 转化实验涉及重组DNA，先做风险评估。
overlay: 转化实验先评估、再审批

shots.section_title: 转化实验先评估、再审批
shots.scene: 法规书本图标和生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a closed law book and a biohazard warning sign side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 要遵守国家生物安全法规。

shots.section_title: 转化实验先评估、再审批
shots.scene: 老周在空白审批表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank approval form at his office desk.
shots.narration: 按本校规定审批备案，批了才能做。

shots.scene: 冰箱里一排贴着空白标签的菌种管
shots.prompt_en: A lab refrigerator shelf with a neat row of small tubes, each with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 菌种和质粒要登记、贴标签、专人保管。

shots.scene: 菌种管被装进口袋带出门的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a tube being put into a pocket and carried out of a door, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不许私自带出，也不许转送他人。

shots.scene: 从室外捡来的未知样品图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of an unknown sample jar from outdoors being brought into the lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不把来历不明的菌株带进实验室。

shots.scene: 小研穿实验服、戴手套和护目镜，在酒精灯旁操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in lab coat, gloves and goggles works carefully next to a lit alcohol lamp.
shots.narration: 接种转化要穿实验服，戴手套和护目镜。

shots.scene: 嘴吸移液管的图标被打叉，旁边是移液器打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icon of mouth pipetting crossed out with a red X, next to a hand pipette with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不用嘴吸液，用移液器。

shots.scene: 酒精灯旁边的酒精瓶被移远
shots.prompt_en: Icon of an alcohol bottle being moved away from a lit alcohol lamp, with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 灼烧接种环时，酒精瓶远离火焰。

shots.scene: 小研擦拭消毒台面后洗手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the bench with disinfectant, then washes her hands at the sink.
shots.narration: 做完消毒台面，摘手套洗手。

shots.scene: 阿杰凑近紫外灯直视的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a person staring directly into a purple ultraviolet lamp, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 看荧光要用紫外灯，紫外线伤眼伤皮肤。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上防紫外面罩和手套，观察平板
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears a UV face shield and gloves while viewing a glowing plate under a lamp.
shots.narration: 戴防紫外面罩或护目镜，不直视灯管。

shots.scene: 用过的平板、吸头、接种环装进灭菌袋
shots.prompt_en: Used petri dishes, pipette tips and inoculation loops placed into an autoclave bag. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的平板、吸头和接种环，

shots.scene: 灭菌袋放进高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: An autoclave bag placed inside an open autoclave chamber. No people.
shots.narration: 先高压灭菌，杀灭全部活菌。

shots.scene: 平板扔进生活垃圾桶、菌液倒进水槽的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a petri dish thrown into a household trash bin and liquid culture poured into a sink, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不能直接扔垃圾桶，也不能倒下水道。

shots.scene: 细菌和抗生素盾牌图标外面画着隔离圈
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a bacterium carrying a shield symbol enclosed inside a containment circle. No people.
shots.narration: 转化菌带抗性基因，不能让它外泄。

shots.scene: 灭菌后的袋子投入感染性废物桶
shots.prompt_en: A sealed bag placed into a biohazard waste bin after sterilization. No people.
shots.narration: 灭活后按感染性废物交学校处置。

shots.scene: 菌液洒在台面上，小研用吸水纸覆盖
shots.prompt_en: Some liquid culture is spilled on the bench, and the female graduate student covers it with absorbent paper.
shots.narration: 菌液洒了，先用吸水纸覆盖。

shots.scene: 消毒液从外向内倒在吸水纸上的示意图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of disinfectant being poured onto absorbent paper from the edge toward the center. No people.
shots.narration: 从外向内倒消毒液，按规定作用后再清。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告，老周点头记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man, who nods and writes on a blank form.
shots.narration: 沾到皮肤立即冲洗，并报告负责人。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现质粒环、剪刀和细菌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a plasmid ring, molecular scissors and a bacterium.
shots.narration: 质粒能剪开、插入，在细菌里复制。

shots.scene: 四个平板图标，只有第四个发光
shots.prompt_en: Icons of four petri dishes, only the fourth one glowing green. No people.
shots.narration: 抗性筛选转化菌，阿拉伯糖开启发光。

shots.scene: 评估表和审批章图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank checklist and a round approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 转化实验，先评估审批，菌种严管。

shots.scene: 护目镜、防紫外面罩和手套图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles, a UV face shield and gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 做好防护，看荧光别直视紫外灯。

shots.scene: 灭菌器和感染性废物桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an autoclave and a biohazard waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 培养物先灭活，再按规定处置。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个发光的培养皿挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a closed glowing petri dish and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 弄懂原理，守好规矩，下次见！
